defmodule MessageQueue.ConnectionPool do
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:connections, :pending, :max_size, :checkout_timeout]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    max_size = Keyword.get(opts, :max_size, 10)
    state = %__MODULE__{
      connections: :queue.new(),
      pending: :queue.new(),
      max_size: max_size,
      checkout_timeout: Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, 5000)
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def checkout do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :checkout, 10_000)
  end

  def checkin(conn) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:checkin, conn})
  end

  def handle_call(:checkout, from, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.connections) do
      {{:value, conn}, rest} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, conn}, %{state | connections: rest}}
      {:empty, _} ->
        pending = :queue.in(from, state.pending)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending: pending}}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn}, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.pending) do
      {{:value, waiter}, rest} ->
        GenServer.reply(waiter, {:ok, conn})
        {:noreply, %{state | pending: rest}}
      {:empty, _} ->
        conns = :queue.in(conn, state.connections)
        {:noreply, %{state | connections: conns}}
    end
  end
end

defmodule MessageQueue.Consumer do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:queue_name, :handler, :conn, :channel, :consumer_tag,
             :shutting_down, :inflight_count, :max_inflight]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    state = %__MODULE__{
      queue_name: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :queue),
      handler: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :handler),
      shutting_down: false,
      inflight_count: 0,
      max_inflight: Keyword.get(opts, :max_inflight, 100)
    }
    send(self(), :connect)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def handle_info(:connect, state) do
    case MessageQueue.ConnectionPool.checkout() do
      {:ok, conn} ->
        {:ok, channel} = open_channel(conn)
        {:ok, tag} = subscribe(channel, state.queue_name)
        {:noreply, %{state | conn: conn, channel: channel, consumer_tag: tag}}
      {:error, _reason} ->
        Process.send_after(self(), :connect, 1000)
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:basic_deliver, payload, meta}, state) do
    if state.shutting_down do
      reject_message(state.channel, meta.delivery_tag, true)
      {:noreply, state}
    else
      new_state = process_message(payload, meta, state)
      {:noreply, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:task_complete, delivery_tag, :ok}, state) do
    ack_message(state.channel, delivery_tag)
    new_count = state.inflight_count - 1
    new_state = %{state | inflight_count: new_count}
    maybe_finish_shutdown(new_state)
  end

  def handle_info({:task_complete, delivery_tag, {:error, _}}, state) do
    reject_message(state.channel, delivery_tag, true)
    new_count = state.inflight_count - 1
    new_state = %{state | inflight_count: new_count}
    maybe_finish_shutdown(new_state)
  end

  def handle_info({:EXIT, _pid, :normal}, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  def handle_info({:EXIT, _pid, reason}, state) do
    Logger.error("Linked process died: #{inspect(reason)}")
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, state) do
    initiate_graceful_shutdown(state)
  end

  defp initiate_graceful_shutdown(state) do
    if state.channel do
      cancel_subscription(state.channel, state.consumer_tag)
    end
    # Wait for inflight messages before returning connection
    wait_for_inflight(state)
    if state.conn do
      MessageQueue.ConnectionPool.checkin(state.conn)
    end
    :ok
  end

  defp wait_for_inflight(%{inflight_count: 0}), do: :ok
  defp wait_for_inflight(state) do
    receive do
      {:task_complete, delivery_tag, :ok} ->
        ack_message(state.channel, delivery_tag)
        wait_for_inflight(%{state | inflight_count: state.inflight_count - 1})
      {:task_complete, delivery_tag, {:error, _}} ->
        reject_message(state.channel, delivery_tag, true)
        wait_for_inflight(%{state | inflight_count: state.inflight_count - 1})
    after
      25_000 -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp process_message(payload, meta, state) do
    parent = self()
    delivery_tag = meta.delivery_tag
    handler = state.handler

    spawn_link(fn ->
      result = try do
        handler.(payload, meta)
      rescue
        e -> {:error, e}
      end
      send(parent, {:task_complete, delivery_tag, result})
    end)

    %{state | inflight_count: state.inflight_count + 1}
  end

  defp maybe_finish_shutdown(state) do
    if state.shutting_down and state.inflight_count == 0 do
      {:stop, :normal, state}
    else
      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp open_channel(conn), do: {:ok, %{conn: conn, id: :erlang.unique_integer()}}
  defp subscribe(channel, _queue), do: {:ok, make_ref()}
  defp cancel_subscription(_channel, _tag), do: :ok
  defp ack_message(_channel, _tag), do: :ok
  defp reject_message(_channel, _tag, _requeue), do: :ok
end

defmodule MessageQueue.Supervisor do
  use Supervisor

  def start_link(opts) do
    Supervisor.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    children = [
      {MessageQueue.ConnectionPool, Keyword.get(opts, :pool_opts, [])},
      consumer_spec(opts)
    ]
    Supervisor.init(children, strategy: :rest_for_one)
  end

  defp consumer_spec(opts) do
    %{
      id: MessageQueue.Consumer,
      start: {MessageQueue.Consumer, :start_link, [
        [queue: "events", handler: &MessageQueue.Handler.process/2]
      ]},
      shutdown: 30_000
    }
  end
end

defmodule MessageQueue.Handler do
  def process(payload, _meta) do
    decoded = Jason.decode!(payload)
    handle_event(decoded)
  end

  defp handle_event(%{"type" => "order"} = event), do: {:ok, event}
  defp handle_event(%{"type" => "notification"} = event), do: {:ok, event}
  defp handle_event(_), do: {:error, :unknown_event}
end
